summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules, reporting on-market share repurchases. On June 2, 2026, the company bought back 2,219,500 A shares at a volume-weighted average price of HKD 61.4071 per share. No board recommendation or advisors were named; the repurchased shares were held as treasury shares. The filing is the Hong Kong equivalent of a US share repurchase disclosure, reflecting an ongoing buyback program. What to watch: continued repurchase activity and the impact on share float, with potential support to share price.
